test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 3rd December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Why do they / keep talking on / about money / all the time?
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **keep talking on**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Remove the prepositi
